name: cppbridge
description: Converts legacy and modern C/C++ (C89/C99/C11/C++11/C++17/C++20) scientific algorithms and systems code into idiomatic, vectorized scientific Python (NumPy, SciPy, Numba, Dataclasses), featuring automated pointer-to-slice conversions, struct-to-dataclass modernization, pybind11 wrapper generation, and closed-loop equivalence verification.
